description: jinaRead only fails-closed on a non-2xx HTTP status (line 23). r.jina.ai frequently returns HTTP 200 with a body that is itself an error/placeholder ('Warning: Target URL returned error', timeout notices, Cloudflare interstitial text, or an empty-ish stub). The success gate at line 37 is merely 'if (body && body.trim())', so such an error body is accepted as a valid source, pushed into the digest, and the run exits 0. This is a fake-success path: the buyer pays USDC and can receive a digest composed of Jina error text rather than real fetched content, while R2 ('cleaned content') and R3 ('NON-EMPTY digest' implying real research) are nominally reported as satisfied. There is no content-quality validation (min real-content length per source, error-string rejection, content-type check).
